SELECT * FROM (SELECT O.* , rownum AS rn FROM (SELECT o_num , o_date, u_member_id, o_payment, SUM(o_price * o_count) + CASE WHEN SUM(o_price * o_count) > 100000 THEN 0 ELSE MAX(pd_shipping_fee) END AS o_price, o_status, o_delivery_state FROM order_tbl o, product_tbl pd WHERE u_member_id = #{u_member_id} AND o.pd_id = pd.pd_id
AND o.o_date >= #{start_date, jdbcType=DATE} AND o.o_date < #{end_date, jdbcType=DATE} + 1
AND
o.o_status = '주문완료'
o.o_delivery_state = '배송준비'
o.o_delivery_state = '배송중'
o.o_delivery_state = '배송완료'
o.o_status = '주문취소'
(o.o_status IN ('주문완료', '주문취소') OR o.o_delivery_state IN ('배송준비', '배송중', '배송완료'))
GROUP BY o_num, u_member_id, o_date, o_status, o_payment, o_delivery_state ORDER BY o_date desc ) O ) WHERE rn BETWEEN #{start} AND #{end}
